metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Like Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You, this is an iconic, endlessly quotable teen comedy with sharp wit and memorable characters.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A witty modern teen comedy based on classic literature, matching the smart, self-aware charm of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: A bright, pink, and deeply uplifting comedy about a bubbly blonde proving herself, carrying the exact same joyful energy as Clueless.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: This beloved classic offers a perfect blend of fantasy, action, adventure, and humor, sharing a DNA with Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A lighthearted jungle adventure-comedy featuring stellar star-chemistry, matching the fun energy of the modern Jumanji films.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you loved Wake Up Dead Man, experience the brilliant, star-studded mystery-comedy that launched the franchise.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: This sequel delivers another colorful, comedic, and incredibly fun whodunnit mystery with a fantastic ensemble cast.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written and directed by Shane Black, this film features the exact same sharp-witted buddy-cop dynamic and crime-comedy style as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A highly-rated mystery action-comedy with excellent pacing, brilliant ensemble chemistry, and hilarious twists.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Directed by James Gunn, this Marvel adventure matches the colorful aesthetic, retro soundtrack, and irreverent humor of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A heartwarming, high-concept comedy set in a video game world, perfect for fans of Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A fantastic, romantic, and highly comedic fantasy adventure that mirrors the whimsy and fun of Practical Magic and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful blend of fantasy, romance, and comedy that gently pokes fun at fairy tale tropes, making for perfect comfort-viewing.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: If you enjoyed Sacha Baron Cohen's outrageous and unfiltered mockumentary comedy in Brüno, this is his defining masterpiece.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: An iconic '90s slapstick comedy featuring Jim Carrey at the height of his physical-comedy powers, perfect for fans of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Liar Liar
metas.description: Another Jim Carrey classic that combines rapid-fire physical comedy with a warm, feel-good family redemption story.

metas.name: Bad Moms
metas.description: The predecessor to A Bad Moms Christmas, this R-rated comedy offers the same hilarious, relatable, and chaotic mom-group energy.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: An incredibly fun, charming, and visually impressive creature-feature adventure that hits the perfect balance of humor and heart.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: An outstanding buddy-cop action-comedy with rapid-fire jokes, great kinetic energy, and a mystery at its core.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A clever, star-studded heist comedy about blue-collar siblings, matching the southern-fried humor and crime elements of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: Melissa McCarthy shines in this highly-rated action comedy that brilliantly parodies the spy genre with great action sequences.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good fantasy adventure, combining romance, action, and sharp comedy in a way that defines 'comfort cinema'.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A fast-paced, highly-entertaining horror-comedy with great ensemble chemistry, action, and hilarious survival rules.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: For fans of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl, this film offers a visually stunning, whimsical, and romantic journey through a stylized Paris.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A stylized, high-octane action comedy filled with colorful characters, witty banter, and chaotic fun on a Japanese bullet train.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: A modern teen comedy adaptating Shakespeare (Twelfth Night) filled with hilarious physical comedy, sharing strong ties to 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A high-energy, competitive, and colorful teen comedy that has captured the same cult status and comforting rewatchability as Clueless.

metas.name: We're the Millers
metas.description: A hilarious and raunchy road-trip comedy about a fake family smuggling drugs, matching the wild humor of A Bad Moms Christmas.

metas.name: Step Brothers
metas.description: The ultimate absurdist comfort comedy about two overgrown stepbrothers, perfect for a completely silly and relaxing viewing experience.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: A star-studded, hilarious, and action-packed comedy masterpiece that satirizes Hollywood with incredible performances.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A modern, highly-rated high school comedy with fantastic female-buddy chemistry, smart humor, and a warm heart.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie with the heart of 'Big' and the magic of a fun fantasy adventure, leaning heavily into family-friendly comedy.

metas.name: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
metas.description: A colorful, highly stylish, and campy '90s comedy about two best friends, matching the aesthetic and comedic vibes of Clueless.

metas.name: A Simple Favor
metas.description: A chic, darkly comedic thriller featuring a stylish mystery that will appeal to fans of Knives Out and Get Shorty.

metas.name: Uncharted
metas.description: A fun, globe-trotting treasure hunt full of lighthearted action-adventure, banter, and spectacular set-pieces.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming romantic comedy with a gentle time-travel element, making it a perfect feel-good comfort movie.

metas.name: Snatch
metas.description: A stylized British crime comedy with rapid editing, a complex web of characters, and witty banter, perfect for fans of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: A highly-stylized, fast-paced action comedy that blends spy movie tropes with spectacular choreography and cheeky humor.

metas.name: This Is the End
metas.description: An incredibly fun, meta, and chaotic apocalypse comedy featuring an ensemble of famous comedians playing absurd versions of themselves.

metas.name: Pacific Rim
metas.description: Since you watched the sequel, check out Guillermo del Toro's original blockbuster masterpiece for even bigger, funnier, and more colorful giant-monster action.
